_source: MIRROR — bina-start-school is the source of truth for dates and start-date rules (it is the brain of placement): change config/enrollment.json + config/calendar-2026-27.json there first, then copy here. Copied from bina-start-school/config/calendar-2026-27.json (transcribed 2026-09-14 from the printed 2026/27 bina calendar) + config/enrollment.json. Provisional: replace with the school team's final list when it lands.
_openQuestions: RESOLVED 2026-10-13 (Akis): the final list is biome start + one mid-biome date per biome from November (startDates.midBiome). Mirrors bina-start-school decision #88.
NOINDEX (Akis, 2026-10-05): the plan was to drop the noindex + robots.txt block once the final list landed. Not dropped yet — waiting on Akis's go.
Wed 10 Mar 2027 non-school day inside Rainforest: 'still being confirmed with the school' (Akis quick guide, 2026-09-15).

nonSchoolDays.note: No-school day inside Rainforest (uncoloured on the printed calendar).

startDates._rules: Slack #strategy 2026-09-14 (confirmed by Juli) and #admissions-team 2026-09-15. A Wednesday is a start date only if: 1) inside a biome (no breaks), 2) not a non-school day, 3) not the biome's last day, 4) not the last remaining Wednesday of the biome. Plus each biome's first day (a Monday).
startDates._midBiome: Final (Akis, 2026-10-13): after rollingUntil, each biome's start plus its one mid-biome intake — 'start of biome + 1 intake date only. Simplest to understand for everyone.' Forest moved Mon 5 Jul → Tue 6 Jul 2027 (observed US July 4th holiday, Akis 2026-10-13). Mirrors bina-start-school config/enrollment.json midBiome.
startDates._mirrors: bina-start-school config/enrollment.json biomeFrom = 2026-11-01 (rollingUntil is the day before).
startDates._rollingUntil: Head of school, 2026-10-07: rolling admissions continue through October; from November new children start on biome start dates plus the midBiome dates.
startDates._signBy: Fixed rule (Akis, 2026-10-05): Family Success needs at least 3 business days to onboard, for every start date including biome-start Mondays. Wednesday → sign by the Friday before; Monday → sign by the Wednesday before. Same rule as bina-start-school config/enrollment.json (cutoffBusinessDays).
